annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions (Research report 2)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence in Policing: AI technologies currently used to improve the efficiency and service delivery of police's corporate or enabling functions (Research report 2)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Evidence Based Policing Centre, New Zealand Police
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand Police research report reviewing AI tools used in policing's corporate and enabling functions (documentation, audio/video analysis, data integration, biometrics, call management, community interaction, recruiting). It identifies challenges in performance, integration and governance, privacy, and internal trust, and recommends human-in-the-loop oversight and better governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Explain causes of AI performance inaccuracies such as bias, poor data and lack of context understanding.
Keep a human in the loop with training and continuous oversight of AI outputs.
Ensure effective integration, governance and data architecture, including workflow re-engineering.
Address data privacy and protection concerns, e.g. biometrics and SearchX.
Consider internal trust impacts including deskilling and job-loss fears.
